section10.h2: The dentist you reach is the dentist who treats you.
section10.text: Dr. Anna Gazu founded Marvel Dental in Clifton and leads every case herself. Urgent visits are not handed to whoever is free: she assesses the tooth, explains what she is seeing, and treats it in the same room.
section10.text2: Her work is known for precision and for talking patients through the decision rather than around it, which matters most when someone arrives in pain and has to choose quickly.
section10.credential-text3: Sedation options: nitrous, oral and IV
section10.credential-text4: 3D imaging and an in-house lab on site

footer15.footer-text: Expert dental care with advanced technology, in a comfortable and friendly setting on Main Avenue. We serve Clifton, Passaic, Paterson, Nutley, Garfield and Montclair.
footer15.span2: Urgent visits are scheduled by clinical need and availability. Individual results vary.
